The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: First Bank Studios Operations
podcast.body: Grant McDonald operates his unique musical vision and personal mission out of the "mysterious First Bank studios," which are reportedly located somewhere on the lake in downtown Toronto. This adds to the enigmatic nature of his independent artistic enterprise. "The man is on a personal mission operating out of the mysterious First Bank studios, which is somewhere on the lake in downtown Toronto."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Getty Oil Controversy and Lawsuit
podcast.body: Grant McDonald wrote and directed a 40-minute movie alleging the Getty Oil Company sold oil to the Nazis before Pearl Harbor, with *4 Billion Bucks* serving as its soundtrack. In June 2005, a press release on his website announced a $40 billion lawsuit against Getty Oil regarding these alleged espionage activities during World War II. "A press release issued on Grant's website in June 2005 announced a $40 billion lawsuit against Getty Oil in regards to this alleged espionage in trees and back during World War 2."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Political Correspondence and Persistence
podcast.body: Grant McDonald's website features scans of responses to various letters he has written to both Bill and Hillary Clinton, indicating his deep, single-minded devotion to his cause and vision. He is described as being on a "real quest" with ample time devoted to it. "The same website features scans of responses to various letters Grant has written to both Bill and Hillary Clinton."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Self-Financed Self-Promoter
podcast.body: Grant McDonald, based in Toronto, is noted for being entirely self-financed and an "incredible self-promoter," actively distributing his material and various memorabilia to radio stations across North America. He operates independently in his artistic and activist pursuits. "Other than the fact that he's from Toronto, and that he seems to be completely self-financed and is an incredible self-promoter."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: iTunes Content
podcast.body: It is noted that a search for Grant McDonald's material on iTunes reveals plenty of content, but "most of it is of the hardcore gay porn variety." This unexpected discovery highlights the diverse and often unconventional nature of outsider artist's digital presence. "If you look for Grant's material on iTunes, you will find plenty of it. It's just that most of it is of the hardcore gay porn variety."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
